title: Finite stabilization, socle extensions, and Faith's conjecture
summary: We give a length-two counterexample to the unrestricted product comparison in Bergman's Question 3.1, positive criteria for quasi-injective common modules, and a semidirect-product version of Question 3.2. For semiprimary right self-injective rings, the countable hull construction yields a cyclic two-layer witness, its Baer class, and an opposite-side extension obstruction. We apply this construction over the square-zero ring of the counterexample. The hull quotient of a countable sum of injectives is the endomorphism space modulo finite-rank maps, and computes the full socle-radical defect…
